name: Dumbbell Woodchop
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, and hold one dumbbell with both hands near the outside of one hip.
Pivot through your hips and feet to carry the dumbbell diagonally toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower it under control to the starting hip, then guide it across to the other hip.
Reverse the diagonal on the next lift and continue alternating sides.
tips: Drive the rotation through your hips and obliques while keeping your arms mostly straight.
Keep your spine tall and avoid rounding your lower back as the dumbbell swings down.
